name: Mini Farm Plot
description: Own a Tree That Feeds Hearts & Homes Not Just Any Tree - One of Our Best 200 from 500+ Senthura Trees Own a fully grown, fruiting Senthura mango tree, organically nurtured for over a decade in the rich, mineral-packed soils of Namakkal, Tamil Nadu. From a grove of more than 500 trees, we've handpicked the top 200 healthiest an
whoIsItFor: Grow real food together as a group and bond through farming. Get chemical-free produce with full farm transparency. Teach kids about farming and sustainability hands-on. Grow your own stock and label it with your store’s name. Own your ingredients for freshness and trust. Experience the joy and truth of real farming
whatYouGet: A 650 sq ft real farm plot, fully maintained for one season. Transparent photo/video updates of your exact plot Organic crops grown naturally, using mulching, bioculture, and native methods. End-of-season harvest delivered to your doorstep. Optional farm visit for families and kids who want to experience real farming
howToTrustItsOrganic: We send regular updates and photos so you can watch your fruit grow on your very own tree - no worries, no guesswork. Farmmily was born to deliver genuinely organic food directly to those who value it, not just sell it in markets. For over 13 years, we’ve followed sustainable, natural farming, because organic food is precious, limited, and never meant to be commercialised. With full transparency, we bring you the true taste of nature — grown just for you

faqs.question: Can I choose the crops for my plot?
faqs.answer: We guide you based on soil, season, and natural compatibility — while keeping you informed.

faqs.question: Is the plot mine to visit?
faqs.answer: Yes! Come anytime during the season to see your crops and meet the farmers.

faqs.question: What if I can’t use all the produce?
faqs.answer: Donate, gift, or resell the extra via Farmmily credits.

faqs.question: Is this better than buying from organic stores?
faqs.answer: 100%. You know where your food is from, how it’s grown, and who grew it.

faqs.question: Can I lease again next season?
faqs.answer: Definitely! Many families come back every season. It’s a journey, not just one harvest.
